Evidence-backed program reduces token spend through reuse paths, short-circuits, cache efficiency, criterion gating/calibration without weakening blocking criteria
Instrumentation must measure Pass-1 token counts (input/output/cache) via sidecar coverage.metrics before cache optimizations land
Blocking criteria (T3, T10, T5c HIGH, G7 contradicts_reality) must use operator-approved thresholds and preserve previously blocking behavior
Pass-1 per-call usage accounting, warm-then-fan-out, and mid-review cancellation are serialized by pass1.py/passes.py file overlap
Criteria routing changes (DET triggers, T3/T10/T5c/G7 blocking, grounded rubrics) are serialized by criteria_routing.json to prevent conflicts
